ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ intersects side $AB$ at point $D$ and side $AC$ at point $E$. If the perimeters of $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle EBC$ are 15 and 9, respectively, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB=AC$, the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is 15. \\
Therefore, $2AC+BC=15$. \\
Since $E$ is on the perpendicular bisector of $AB$, \\
we have $AE=BE$. \\
Since the perimeter of $\triangle BCE$ is $BC+CE+BE=BC+CE+AE=BC+AC=9$, \\
we find $AC=15-9=6$, \\
thus $BC=9-6=\boxed{3}$.
